# K's Code Presence

> AI coding status for Discord: K's Code Presence is an unofficial Windows tray application for showing observable Codex CLI, Codex Desktop, Claude Code, and Antigravity CLI activity in Discord Rich Presence.

## Canonical links

- Website: https://k153636.github.io/codex-discord-presence/
- Source: https://github.com/k153636/codex-discord-presence
- Latest release: https://github.com/k153636/codex-discord-presence/releases/latest
- FAQ: https://k153636.github.io/codex-discord-presence/faq.html
- Compatibility: https://k153636.github.io/codex-discord-presence/compatibility.html
- Data flow: https://k153636.github.io/codex-discord-presence/privacy.html

## Product facts

- Brand: K's Code Presence.
- Product type: local Windows tray application.
- Supported published target: Windows x64.
- Current release: 0.5.0. Dashboard requires Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime.
- Setup and portable distribution: self-contained .NET 10 Desktop Runtime, including automatic-update packages; no separate .NET installation required. Archived standalone EXEs remain .NET 9 builds.
- Discord requirement: Discord Desktop must be running for local Rich Presence delivery.
- Supported tools: Codex Desktop and a separate Codex CLI profile (built in), plus opt-in Claude Code and Antigravity CLI integrations enabled from the Dashboard.
- Claude Code: observational hooks and a statusLine wrapper in ~/.claude/settings.json; shows model, effort, MCP and file activity, terminal spinner labels, Claude Design, subagent party, and cumulative main-session tokens. While waiting, tokens and observed five-hour usage/reset countdown alternate every five seconds with the same formatting as Codex. Estimated cost and usage require matching session/project statusLine evidence; missing values stay unknown and cost is not a subscription charge. Original terminal output is preserved. Prompts, tool output, and source text are discarded.
- Antigravity CLI: official statusLine payload; shows model and effort, plan and quota usage, tool activity, and explicitly reported subagents.
- Main output: one readable Discord activity line with configured details, state, assets, timestamps, and buttons.
- Activity evidence: structured Codex session events and direct tool targets take precedence over fallback file and timestamp evidence.
- MCP behavior: a current MCP operation can replace the normal reasoning, file, or command label with the active server identity.
- Local inputs: Codex session JSONL, Codex configuration, process/window signals, project metadata, and Git metadata according to configuration.
- Hosted service: none operated by this project.
- Affiliation: unofficial community project; not endorsed by OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or Discord.

## Important limits

- macOS and Linux binaries are not promised by the current release.
- The app does not provide a hosted team dashboard or guaranteed live quota data for every plan.
- Configured activity text can expose project names, file labels, or reasoning summaries to Discord.

## Installation

Download `K.CodePresence-win-Setup.exe` from the latest GitHub Release, or extract the entire `K.CodePresence-win-Portable.zip` and launch its root `K's Code Presence.exe`. Both include .NET 10 and support automatic updates. Discord Desktop and WebView2 Runtime are required.
